text:
jia: heads up — product asked for a single 1k-token view that shows cost per 1k, cache savings, and batching delta. want to align on telemetry sources before we sketch UI.

matt: +1. do we want this rolled into the existing cost dashboard or a separate '1k view'?

olivia: separate view makes sense — different filters (route, model-variant, quantization profile). keeps the main dashboard simpler.

ray: telemetry note: runtime emits per-request metrics: tokens_in, tokens_out, kv_cache_hit(bool), batch_size, route_key, model_variant. infra has aggregated cost-per-gpu-token by minute. we can join on minute+route_key.

jia: good. main questions: 1) event schema for cache/batch savings breakdowns? 2) canonical label for route (route_key vs route_id) 3) quota tag mapping for per-customer views

matt: for schema I'd like a compact savings proto: savings_kind ("prefix_cache"|"kv_cache"|"batching"), tokens_saved, usd_equivalent, sample_count. example: ```{"savings_kind":"kv_cache","tokens_saved":1240,"usd_equivalent":0.0024,"sample_count":3}```

olivia: prefer route_id as canonical (stable) and keep route_key as legacy alias. we'll need a small migration in the dashboard join.

ray: infra-bot: pushed a small PR to emit savings proto to kafka topic `telemetry.costs.v2`. consumers: costing-joiner, cost-dashboard. link: https://git.redwood/infra/telemetry/pull/412 :infra-bot: 

jia: thanks. on quotas: product wants toggle to show only requests billed to quota buckets (free-tier vs paid). we need request->quota_bucket mapping in telemetry. can infra emit quota_bucket label?

ray: yes. we can add quota_bucket at emit time. small perf hit but ok. will add to v2 schema.

matt: UX question: rollout behavior — when we flip this dashboard on, how do we avoid churn from model rollouts? want to show both current and baseline model_variant in same view.

olivia: show two series: active_variant (by timestamp) and baseline_variant pinned. add a UI control to pin baseline. default baseline = last stable rollout.

jia: sounds good. implementation plan: (1) infra emits v2 events with route_id, tokens_in/out, batch_size, kv_cache_hit, savings proto, quota_bucket (2) costing-joiner joins infra costs and runtime events into per-minute rollups with fields: route_id, minute_ts, tokens_in, tokens_out, tokens_saved_by_kind[], cost_usd, cost_per_1k_tokens_usd, batch_size_p50/p95, kv_cache_hit_rate, quota_bucket (3) dashboard reads rollups and renders waterfall + table + per-route drilldown.

ray: rough kafka schema attached in PR. also adding a sample of the join query in the PR description.

matt: can we also include batch size distribution histogram? product loves p50/p95 but hist useful for alerting.

olivia: easiest is p50/p95 + a coarse histogram buckets: 1,2,3-8,9-32,33+. runtime can emit batch_bucket label.

jia: okay. timeline? product expects an internal demo next Wed.

ray: infra work (emit v2 + quota_bucket) — 3 days. costing-joiner changes — 2 days. dashboard prototype (devex + product) — 2 days. optimistic: demo on Wed if we start today.

matt: i'll own frontend prototyping. jia will coordinate demo. olivia + ray will own telemetry/schema. i'll add a short PR template for changelog so product can review data mappings.

sarah: dropping a quick question — retention: rollups will be 90 days in hot storage, longer cold. is that OK for customer-facing drilldowns?

jia: 90 days hot is fine for the demo. long-term we can expose archive queries but hide by default.

olivia: one last thought — we should commit to clear naming: `cost_per_1k_tokens_usd` and `tokens_saved_by_kind_{prefix,kvcache,batching}` to avoid parsing ambiguity.

matt: agreed. i'll reflect in dashboard field mapping.

jia: thanks everyone. I'll schedule a 30m sync tomorrow with product + devex to align labels and demo flows. @ray please post the PR links and examples in the thread. :thumbsup:

ray: posted PRs and example join queries. will follow up in the morning with a sample parquet of rollups for frontend mock.

infra-bot: deploy job telemetry-emitter/v2 started for staging (build 2026.3.12-79)

jia: perfect — wrapping up here. will share meeting invite.
